input_source: Certificate(const bytes& der) receives one CertData.data element; the production X509Credential tls::istream decoder reads a vector of individually bounded CertData values and constructs one Certificate per element.
input_length_semantics: der is a bounded bytes vector; der.data() is the start and static_cast<int>(der.size()) is passed as the parser length. Each certificate-chain element is parsed in a separate call.

evidence: Certificate is singular and its constructor accepts one bytes value (certificate.cpp:377-380).
X509Credential iterates der_chain and constructs one Certificate from each cert.data (src/credential.cpp:54-58).
CertData contains one bytes data field (include/mls/credential.h:31-38).

full_consumption_check.evidence: buf is initialized to der.data() and passed by address, but no comparison with der.data() + der.size() follows before return (certificate.cpp:92-102).

flow: leaf public key extraction and signature-scheme selection (src/credential.cpp:60-64)
adjacent certificate signature validation via Certificate::valid_from -> X509_verify (src/credential.cpp:66-70; certificate.cpp:423-428)

Credential::valid_for can compare the leaf certificate public key with the MLS SignaturePublicKey and is invoked by LeafNode::sign and credential-binding paths (src/credential.cpp:86-90,196-219,281-291; src/core_types.cpp:188-202)
LeafNode::verify checks the X509 signature scheme and verifies with the separately stored signature_key; no credential.valid_for call is present in that function (src/core_types.cpp:205-220)

parsed_certificate_sink: subject, issuer, SAN, SKID, AKID, validity and CA fields

identity_comparison.mechanism: X509Credential::valid_for compares the leaf certificate public key serialization with SignaturePublicKey in explicit sign and credential-binding paths; Certificate equality separately compares retained raw input bytes. LeafNode::verify does not call credential.valid_for in the inspected function.

fingerprint_computation.mechanism: ParsedCertificate::compute_digest calls X509_digest with EVP_sha256; issuer_hash and subject_hash are also computed.

raw_input_handling.mechanism: Certificate(const bytes&) stores raw(der); Certificate equality compares raw bytes; X509Credential equality compares der_chain.

buildability.evidence: The production hpke target is an add_library target and find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED) is present; no build was run in this static-only phase.

existing_equivalent_fix.evidence: No full-consumption comparison exists at the fixed commit. Local git -S history shows the introducing certificate API commit, but no internet issue/PR search was performed in the narrowed local-only phase.

limitations: No runtime parser behavior was tested.
No real deployment or service reachability was evaluated.

input_source: Public library API receives a bounded bytes buffer and creates BIO_new_mem_buf(pem.data(), pem.size()).
input_length_semantics: The BIO is bounded by the entire pem bytes vector, but the function intentionally calls PEM_read_bio_X509 repeatedly and returns std::vector<Certificate>.

evidence: A while(true) loop repeatedly reads X509 objects (certificate.cpp:402-417).
PEM_R_NO_START_LINE is treated as end of objects (certificate.cpp:406-410).

full_consumption_check.evidence: No BIO_eof, BIO_pending or BIO_ctrl_pending check exists; however the function loops over certificate objects until PEM_R_NO_START_LINE, so leftover object handling is intentional stream/multi-object behavior.

flow: Certificate::parse_pem is implemented in production library source.
The only direct in-repository caller found is lib/hpke/test/certificate.cpp:570.

parsed_certificate_sink: public-key extraction when Certificate objects are later used

chain_validation.evidence: parse_pem itself only returns parsed objects; it does not call X509_verify or X509_verify_cert.

identity_comparison.evidence: parse_pem itself performs no identity comparison.

fingerprint_computation.mechanism: Constructing ParsedCertificate computes X509_digest with SHA-256.

raw_input_handling.mechanism: Each PEM object is reserialized with i2d_X509 in the ParsedCertificate-based Certificate constructor.

buildability.evidence: Same hpke library target; no build was run in this static-only phase.

existing_equivalent_fix.evidence: Exact single-object full-consumption is not the declared behavior of this function.
